entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker bound by a demonic contract, who infiltrates the Aether Spire to kill Tezzeret and sees the Gatewatch as people to manipulate.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker artificer with an etherium arm, building the planar portal while working to pay a debt to Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage who wrecked Tezzeret's mind years ago on Ravnica.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who shields Chandra with his golden glow during the crash into the Spire; Liliana mocks him with nicknames.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who rides the thopter into the Spire and survives with Gideon's protection.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who holds power over Tezzeret and once employed Liliana on Ravnica.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: The inventor whose transporter became the planar portal.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: One of Liliana's unresolved issues, tied to the Chain Veil.

entities.name: The Raven Man
entities.description: An unresolved issue from Liliana's past.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A demon stronger than Kothophed and Griselbrand who still holds power over Liliana and is on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon bound to Liliana by contract who fell relatively easily.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon bound to Liliana by contract who fell relatively easily.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group Liliana plans to use against Razaketh.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: The government whose soldiers guard the Spire.

entities.name: The Renegades
entities.description: Rebel inventors fighting in Ghirapur.

entities.name: The Infinite Consortium
entities.description: An interplanar consortium Liliana helped Bolas pursue on Ravnica.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The war-torn city on Kaladesh.

entities.name: The Aether Spire
entities.description: The tower housing Tezzeret's planar portal workshop.

entities.name: Caligo Forest
entities.description: A dark forest of Dominaria where young Liliana fled a battle.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane whose ancient history was marked by planar portals.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where Tezzeret's mind was wrecked four years ago.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where Razaketh is.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Plane Chandra left to join the Gatewatch.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes that Rashmi glimpsed.

entities.name: The Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact whose power Liliana draws on at a bloody cost.

entities.name: Tezzeret's planar portal
entities.description: A ring within a ring of whorls and pipes that Tezzeret has activated.

entities.name: Hope of Ghirapur
entities.description: The oversized thopter carrying Chandra into the Spire.

entities.name: Heart of Kiran
entities.description: The renegade airship that carried the thopter past the blockade.

entities.name: Liliana's zombie
entities.description: A zombie Liliana raises from a dead renegade as bodyguard.

entities.name: Tezzeret's scrap construct
entities.description: A hulking construct of sharp-edged metal that defends Tezzeret.

events.summary: Liliana arrives in the war-torn streets of Ghirapur, recalling Caligo Forest, resolved to kill Tezzeret.
Liliana recalls working for Bolas and turning Jace against Tezzeret, and Jace wrecking Tezzeret's mind on Ravnica four years ago.
events.quote: Jace had wrecked Tezzeret's mind and left him for dead on some remote plane.

events.summary: Liliana raises a dead renegade as a zombie bodyguard.
events.quote: She waved a hand in its direction, and a new zombie struggled to its feet.

events.summary: Liliana notes the vortex of energy around the Spire and guesses Tezzeret has activated the portal.
events.quote: Liliana guessed that Tezzeret had activated that portal.

events.summary: Liliana stuns the Consulate soldiers at a barricade without killing them and enters the Spire.
events.quote: just enough mana to suck the breath from their lungs until their vision went black and their knees buckled

events.summary: Liliana attacks Tezzeret in the portal chamber; a scrap construct shields him.
events.quote: a hulk of sharp-edged metal detached itself from the heaps of junk around the edges of the room

events.summary: Tezzeret claims credit for Rashmi's invention and taunts Liliana about Jace and the Gatewatch.
events.quote: She would have been sending vases across Ghirapur forever if I hadn't guided her tiny little mind.

events.summary: Liliana drains Tezzeret's life using the Chain Veil and her zombie attacks him.
events.quote: Tezzeret clutched at his throat and fell to his knees

events.summary: Liliana realizes Tezzeret is working for Bolas to pay a debt.
events.quote: "Oh," Liliana breathed. "Oh. You're here for Bolas."

events.summary: Liliana pins Tezzeret under her heel and forces him to reveal Bolas is on Amonkhet, home of the demon Razaketh.
Liliana realizes she must eventually confront Razaketh, one of two remaining demons, and says Amonkhet aloud.
The oversized thopter bursts toward the Spire with Chandra's red hair visible at its tip.
events.quote: she caught a glimpse as she ducked behind the wall, of flaming red hair at the tip of the oversized thopter.

events.summary: Gideon shields Chandra with his golden glow as she builds a star of flame for the impact.
The explosion destroys Tezzeret's gate and buries Liliana in rubble; Tezzeret's fate is unknown.
events.quote: A huge column of smoke boiled up from where Tezzeret's gate had stood.

events.summary: Liliana searches the rubble and reflects that she needs Chandra and the Gatewatch as powerful tools to free herself from her demons.
events.quote: She needed powerful people, and she'd found them.

events.summary: Liliana finds Chandra and Gideon alive; Tezzeret is either buried or has fled to his master.
events.quote: "He's either buried in this rubble or run home to his master."

relations.note: Tezzeret works to pay off a debt to Bolas.
relations.quote: I'm working to pay off a debt.
Jace had wrecked Tezzeret's mind and left him for dead on some remote plane.

relations.note: She once worked for the dragon on Ravnica.
relations.quote: Liliana had been working for the dragon then

relations.note: A demon holding power over her via contract.
relations.quote: Razaketh was stronger than either of them.

relations.note: Griselbrand fell thanks to the Chain Veil.
relations.quote: Kothophed and Griselbrand had fallen relatively easily, thanks to the Chain Veil.

relations.note: He shields her with golden light.
Gatewatch members welcomed her into the fold.
relations.quote: the other members of the Gatewatch had welcomed her into the fold

relations.note: He builds the gate from Rashmi's invention.
relations.quote: "Did they come to see my magnificent gate?"
